titulo: Conjugate poder in the simple future
subtitulo: Poder loses its e before the endings: podré, podrás, podremos.
regla: Poder drops the e of its infinitive to make the stem podr-, then adds -é, -ás, -á, -emos, -án.

bloques.texto: **Poder** (_to be able to, can_) is irregular in the **simple future** (also called **futuro imperfecto**). The endings are the normal ones; only the stem changes.
Instead of using the whole infinitive (**poder-**), the **e** disappears and the stem is **podr-**.
Every form except **podremos** carries a written accent on the ending.
Tip: the future is in a hurry, so **poder** swallows its **e**: **pod(e)ré** → **podré**.

lista.es: Mañana no ==podré== abrir el Tsuru del cliente; no tengo la herramienta.
lista.en: Tomorrow I won't be able to open the customer's Tsuru; I don't have the tool.

lista.es: ¿==Podrás== llegar a Rosarito a las siete?
lista.en: Will you be able to get to Rosarito at seven?

lista.es: Beto ==podrá== rolar otra vez cuando sane su rodilla.
lista.en: Beto will be able to roll again when his knee heals.

lista.es: En el huerto ==podremos== cosechar chiles en un mes.
lista.en: In the garden we'll be able to harvest chiles in a month.
You won't be able to get in without a key.

lista.es: No sé si Naomi ==podrá== arreglar el Rocinante a tiempo.
lista.en: I don't know if Naomi will be able to fix the Rocinante in time.

bloques.texto: The regular pattern would keep the whole infinitive. With **poder** that's wrong.

lista.nota: The **ue** of the present (**puedo**) never appears in the future.

filas.t: Ya confirmaron: ellos podrían venir mañana.
Ya confirmaron: ellos podrán venir mañana.

lista.nota: It's confirmed, so it's the future: **podrán** (_will be able_). **Podrían** (_could_) is the conditional, with **-ía**.

secciones.titulo: Other verbs that drop the e

lista.texto: **saber** → **sabr-**, **caber** → **cabr-**. See [[5245|caber and saber in the future]].
The endings are the same as for every verb in the future: [[5155|regular verbs in the simple future]].
The present is a different story (**o** → **ue**): [[5564|poder in the present]].
The conditional uses the very same stem, with **-ía** endings: [[5853|the conditional]].
The future also guesses about right now: [[5060|the future for probability]].
The future of **haber** + participle: [[5066|irregular verbs in the future perfect]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: **Poder**, **nosotros**: El sábado ___ surfear en Baja Malibú.
lista.r: El sábado podremos surfear en Baja Malibú.

lista.p: In Spanish: _I won't be able to train tomorrow._
Which one? **¿Poderás abrir la puerta?** or **¿Podrás abrir la puerta?**
